profile_text.body:
Apple is a public company founded in 1976 and headquartered in Cupertino, CA, that designs consumer hardware, software, and services. Its AI-focused web presence centers on Apple Intelligence and a next-generation version of Siri, which the company describes as "truly helpful AI that's centered around you and your needs," integrated into iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27. The company describes the system as private at every step, with processing handled on-device where possible.

Apple Intelligence is the company's core AI platform, tracked in the Chat and General LLMs category, and is characterized by on-device processing, Private Cloud Compute, and Apple silicon optimization with minimal data exposure. The next-generation Siri, powered by Apple Intelligence, is described on the company's site as capable of open-ended conversation, in-app actions across Messages, Music, and Reminders, visual queries via screenshot or Apple Pencil, real-world object recognition, writing assistance, and Shortcuts automation. Apple also tracks Final Cut Pro AI and iMovie AI as AI-assisted video editing products, both emphasizing on-device processing on Apple silicon. The company notes Siri AI will launch in beta and will not initially be available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS, or watchOS.

Apple is a publicly traded company on the ticker AAPL with SEC CIK 0000320193. Its most recently reported annual revenue, from a 10-K covering the period ending 2025-09-27, was $416,161,000,000. Two MCP servers are associated with the company in the registry: one for managing Apple Ads campaigns and reporting, and one providing Apple Developer Documentation with semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI reranking. No litigation is recorded in the held facts.
